answer: By combining recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with a verifiable delay primitive, we restrict identity cloning. Requiring a locked staking collateral of fifty tokens forces a negative expected attack utility via automated slashing penalties. Our protocol reaches its zenith of security when the delay sequentiality acts as an unyielding reef against parallel computation. This design renders malicious simulation of historical states as impossible as carving ivory, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium where honesty remains optimal.
